author: reek
body: Boots with a GPT image attached whose FAT16 ESP holds AGENT.GGU and a signed AGENT.MAN, and prints the verdict of the whole bundled-agent chain.

author: reek
body: The disk is built by `build/agent-bundle-test.ps1`, which runs this same binary four times: once against an honest bundle and three times against bundles with one link of the chain broken. A single expected file cannot hold four answers, so this test's `.expected` pins only the honest one and the harness owns the negative controls. Without them a verifier that answered BUNDLE OK unconditionally would pass here, which is the whole failure this chain exists to prevent.
